cues.heading: Sit upright
cues.text: Sit on a stable chair with both feet resting on the floor.

cues.heading: Straighten the knee
cues.text: Lift the foot of your exercise leg by slowly straightening your knee.

cues.heading: Keep your thigh supported
cues.text: Keep your thigh on the seat. Straighten only as far as comfortable.

cues.heading: Lower with control
cues.text: Bend your knee slowly and return your foot to the floor.

cues.heading: Stay steady
cues.text: Keep your body upright. Avoid swinging your leg or leaning backwards.

cues.heading: Follow your plan
cues.text: Use your prescribed repetitions and holds. Stop for sharp pain.
